Name: Far Territory
Author: Jared
Description: Far Territory (early development): lands beyond the forest, reached by ordinary travel. This version adds the coast at the end of the river: south from Duck Point to Brackwater Mouth, then east to Driftwood Shore and Seaward Sands, with driftwood, shells and stones to gather, a sea to wash and dive in and a tide pool to forage on Seaward Sands, and an outrigger canoe that sails from Seaward Sands to Landfall Strand, the island's first beach, and back. The island is warm and snow-free whatever the forest's season, and its whole coast can be explored: Coral Inlet, Boulder Shore, Palm Fringe, Rootwater Thicket, Bleak Strand and Cliffbound Cove, and Gull Stack, a gull islet reached only by swimming. Inland, the whole interior: Vine Woods, the Westgrass and Eastgrass Plains, Reed Marsh, Green Deep, Hidden Vale, Misty Ridge, the Western and Eastern Uplands, Fire Mountain (a volcano, much hotter than the rest of the island) and Sour Crater, its acid lake, a shipwreck on dry ground in Wreck Hollow and the old ruin of Fallen Dwelling, joined by compass hops, paths and climbs that can end in a fall. A dugout canoe carries you down the river to Brackwater Mouth in one paddle. Coconut palms on the island's coast to climb or fell, with the coconut chain (husk, crack, drink, eat and a shell bowl that collects rain) and palms that regrow. Tropical food plants (banana, mango, tropical almond, wild jujube, nipa palm, wild yam and the sago palm) to pick or fell for raw food, each also grown in the base game's Garden Plot. Medicine and spice plants (ginger, kava, chilli, lemongrass, jasmine, aloe vera, cinchona and coffee), also grown in the Garden Plot, with remedies whose effects wear off: aloe for burns, cinchona for fever, kava for stress, coffee to stay awake and ginger for nausea. Fibre and flowering plants (China rose, spider lily, weevil lily and snake grass), also grown in the Garden Plot: China roses to eat, a spider lily poultice for aches, and weevil lily and snake grass that strip into the base game's own fibres for twine. Fish every coast with any rod, line or net, spear fish and set a fish trap or the base game's funnel trap on the calm shores, and dive for shellfish: each coast has its own catch, and every fish is weighted by a hidden population that each catch lowers and time restores. Eight caves off the paper map, each a few steps from a shore or hill (a sea grotto, a wet wave grotto, a plain grotto, a bat roost, a monkey den, a black grotto that is dark and needs a light, a sinkhole you climb into and a lava tube), each with a small forage layer, and behind them a chain of eight dark halls (a dripping hall with a spring, a tight squeeze, crystal, flooded and copper-veined halls) joined by crawls, climbs and an underwater swim from Cliffbound Cove. Island animals to meet and fight: macaques, monitor lizards, cobras, seagulls and bats, whose bites land as the base game's bite wound, carcasses to butcher, and a seagull nest on Gull Stack to search for eggs. The island's seas bite back: a shark can bite you as you wash, dive or spear fish, sea kraits strike in Coral Inlet and Rootwater Thicket, and urchins lie underfoot, all landing as the base game's wounds, with footwear keeping out the urchins and the kraits. The first far land, a grassland west of the forest: a game trail found by foraging in the Western Wild Woods walks you to Wildrye Plain and Sedge Fen, where this mod's moose roams (fight it or leave it alone; its carcass gives meat, hide, bones and an antler), and with Harsh Wilds installed a search of the grazing grounds can turn up a wisent or (in winter) a musk ox carcass. The mountains north of the forest: a goat trail found by foraging in Fangvale climbs to Scree Slope and Steaming Shelf, where the air is colder than the forest's, a hot spring washes you and warms you for hours, and a rock salt seam gives salt; a greenstone grotto with two copper veins; and, up a cliff that needs rope and pitons in your hand, Windgap Col with a rust grotto (iron ore) and a glimmer grotto (stone and the odd geode). Rope and pitons are a new blueprint that raises your Climbing Aid while held. The fjords beyond the mountains, a compass hop north of Windgap Col: Fjord Head, Seal Skerry and Puffin Cliffs, colder still than the mountains, with an icy fjord to wash in and watch for seals and whales far out, seals, walrus and puffins to meet and fight (seal and walrus carcasses to butcher), and with Harsh Wilds installed a musk ox carcass to find in the snow in winter. With Forest Lore installed, its Standing Stones also stand on the grassland's Wildrye Plain. Requires CSFFModFramework 2.28.0 or later.
